notes.title: Version 0.19.4
notes.notes:
We've added a settings menu to the options screen. 
In addition, we've implemented several fixes due to the recent physics update.
If you find any more issues, please feel to report them as a reply to this post.

Thank you for your continued support!

- Grand Hawk

notes.title: Version 0.19.2
notes.notes:
Another small update to add compatibility of the UI for Steamdeck.
There are also a couple of misc. bug-fixes.

-Grand Hawk

notes.title: Physics Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone - just a small update to ensure you we are still working on the game.

This update features improved bomb physics as well as many misc. bug fixes.

Most of the work we've been putting in has been going towards the new stages, but they are still not quite ready yet. Thank you for your patience.

Feel free to leave your feedback for how we can make Knights of the Exploding Table the best it can be!

- Grand Hawk

notes.title: Build Version 0.17.9
notes.notes:
Build Version 0.17.9

This update fixes an issue with extra diagonal force applied to creatures moving at high speeds.

The Green Forest music is also slightly updated again.

We're hard at work on making the Purple Cave land available, but we're still a ways off. 

Thank you for your patience.

notes.title: Version 0.17.8
notes.notes:
- Added a recommendation to use a controller when one isn't plugged in.

- Gave signs 5 HP to make them less likely to be destroyed before the player can read them.

notes.title: Build Version 0.17.7
notes.notes:
This small update fixes a lighting issue some users were having in the opening video.

A special thanks to Akahoshi whose video made me aware of the issue.

-Grand Hawk Union
